# transmit_oncall_schedule (Resource)

A schedule: one or more rotations that decide who is on call. Escalation policy steps can page whoever a schedule has on call.

A rotation keeps its id while its `name` is unchanged, so overrides that cover it survive edits. Renaming or removing a rotation that an override still covers is refused; delete those overrides first. Overrides are managed with `transmit_oncall_schedule_override` and are not affected by this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "transmit_oncall_schedule" "primary" {
  configuration_id = transmit_oncall_configuration.prod.id
  name             = "Primary"
  timezone         = "America/New_York"
  owner_team_id    = transmit_oncall_team.sre.id

  # Business hours hand off daily; nights and weekends weekly.
  rotation {
    name          = "Weekly"
    cadence       = "weekly"
    starts_at     = "2026-11-02T09:00:00-05:00"
    responder_ids = [transmit_oncall_responder.dana.id, transmit_oncall_responder.lee.id]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration_id` (String) The on-call configuration this belongs to. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `name` (String)
- `timezone` (String) IANA time zone the rotations hand off in, such as `America/New_York`.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) A disabled schedule pages nobody. Defaults to `true`.
- `owner_team_id` (String) Team that owns the schedule.
- `rotation` (Block List) A rotation. Names must be unique within the schedule (case-insensitive). Order is preserved. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rotation))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `rotation_ids` (Map of String) Rotation ids by rotation name, for `transmit_oncall_schedule_override.rotation_ids`.

<a id="nestedblock--rotation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rotation`

Required:

- `cadence` (String) `hourly`, `daily` or `weekly`.
- `name` (String)
- `responder_ids` (List of String) Responders in hand-off order.
- `starts_at` (String) When the first shift starts, as RFC 3339 with an explicit offset.

Optional:

- `ends_at` (String) When the rotation stops. Omit for no end.
- `interval` (Number) Hand off every `interval` cadence units. Defaults to `1`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <configuration_id>/<schedule_id>
terraform import transmit_oncall_schedule.primary 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002
```
